program.name: Bell Complexes
program.subject: Kettlebell only
program.blurb: Kettlebell complexes as EMOMs: chain several moves each minute without putting the bell down, then strength work.
program.about: Kettlebell complexes as EMOMs: chain several moves each minute without putting the bell down. Strength work in straight sets follows the complex, on two alternating days. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder variations. For grip, conditioning and flow with one bell.
program.gear: Level III: a 20–24 kg kettlebell helps
